reviews.review: Mouse controls didn't really work, not sure why, which make selecting menu options a little annoying. Gameplay is as expected, it meets the requirements of the genre without doing anything novel. Adding the slime pal doesn't do enough to differentiate this game from the other. better, games. You definitely want to be moving across the map to collect chests for upgrades rather than staying in a finite area. The sword weapon feels awful, maybe it's better upgraded but it's vastly inferior to the staff and bow as far as the starter weapons go. I think it's questionable to make something like Vampire Survivors, with pixel-style graphics even, and make it even simpler and less impressive.  The game is okay, there's nothing wrong with it, but Vampire Survivors is already cheap. I wouldn't recommend this unless you really needed a different, cheap, play in the background, timewasting game.
